cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Carry This with Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put N/A on Mum's care-home forms like you. Take half; being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: N/A means it doesn't apply. I put it under driving licence; you've put it under medication.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, leave room for the medicines. Sit beside me and read the questions out; we'll decide together before you write anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It only allows one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll sit with you for the first call; you shouldn't have to handle it alone either.
